religion.pick: Which faith is {label} best known for founding or launching?
religion.statement: {label} is closely linked with the start of {value}.
religion.match: Match each figure to the faith they are linked with.
religion.reverse: Who is most closely linked with the start of {value}?

rows.label: Jesus Christ
rows.description: central figure of Christianity (c. 6 or 4 BC – AD 30 or 33)
rows.hook: is believed by his followers to be the Son of God who was crucified and rose again

rows.label: Muhammad
rows.description: Arabian political leader and the founder of Islam (c. 570–632)
rows.hook: is regarded by followers as the final prophet, who received the Quran and lived in Mecca and Medina

rows.label: The Buddha
rows.description: Indian philosopher and the founder of Buddhism (623 or 563 BCE – 543 or 483 BCE)
rows.hook: sat beneath a fig tree, reached enlightenment and taught the Middle Way

rows.label: Martin Luther
rows.hook: nailed a list of 95 complaints about church practices to a door in Wittenberg

rows.label: Joseph Smith
rows.description: American religious leader and founder of the Latter Day Saint movement (1805–1844)
rows.hook: said he translated the Book of Mormon from golden plates an angel showed him

rows.label: Confucius
rows.hook: taught filial piety and ethical rule, with his sayings collected in the Analects

rows.label: Zoroaster
rows.hook: was a Persian prophet who taught worship of the wise lord Ahura Mazda

rows.label: Guru Nanak
rows.description: First Sikh Guru and founder of Sikhism
rows.hook: taught devotion to one God and equality of all people in the Punjab region of South Asia

rows.label: Laozi
rows.description: 6th-century BC semi-legendary Chinese philosopher, founder of Taoism
rows.hook: is credited with writing the Tao Te Ching, a short classic of Chinese philosophy

rows.label: Helena Blavatsky
rows.hook: co-founded a New York society blending Eastern mysticism with Western occultism

rows.label: Ann Lee
rows.hook: led English emigrants to America, in a group known for simple furniture and ecstatic dance

rows.label: Baháʼu'lláh
rows.hook: was exiled from Persia and taught the unity of all religions and all humanity

rows.label: Emmanuel Swedenborg
rows.hook: was a scientist who claimed visions of heaven and hell and wrote about the afterlife

rows.label: Báb
rows.description: founder of Bábism and, according to the Baháʼís, predecessor of Baháʼu'lláh
rows.hook: declared himself the herald of a coming divine messenger in Persia and was executed by firing squad

rows.label: Mary Baker Eddy
rows.hook: founded a Boston church stressing spiritual healing and launched a respected daily newspaper
